name: metainfo-collector
description: Reports page loads (people, AI crawlers, search engines) from your site's edge to MetaInfo's Traffic page.

METAINFO_TOKEN.description: The collector token from MetaInfo's Traffic page (starts with mtr_).

METAINFO_ORG.description: Your workspace id from MetaInfo's Traffic page (org_... or user_...).

METAINFO_SITE.description: Your site's URL as shown on the Traffic page, e.g. https://example.com.

METAINFO_ENDPOINT.description: Only for a self-hosted MetaInfo: https://your-metainfo/api/traffic/events. Leave the default otherwise.
